# Soham Sawalakhe — Software Developer & AI/ML Engineer

## Summary
Soham Sawalakhe (Soham Manish Sawalakhe) is a Software Developer, AI/ML Engineer, and Computer Engineering student based in Amravati, Maharashtra, India. He works as a Backend Developer at SitaraHub and has published research in Scopus-indexed international journals.

## Key Projects

### 1. Covert Database Detection Engine (AI/ML & Security)
- **Technologies**: Python, Tkinter, Scikit-learn, Stegano, Cryptography
- **Description**: High-precision forensic application to detect hidden databases using steganography, cryptography, and machine learning. Achieved 90% detection accuracy. Published in a Scopus-indexed journal.
- **Link**: https://github.com/SohamSawalakhe/Covert-Database-Detection

### 2. Library Management System (Full Stack)
- **Technologies**: Django, Django REST Framework, MySQL, Bootstrap
- **Description**: Enterprise dual-interface management system with role-based access control (RBAC), JWT authentication, and automated book issue/return tracking.
- **Link**: https://github.com/SohamSawalakhe/Library-Management-System

### 3. Customer Data Platform (CDP) Chatbot
- **Technologies**: Python, NLP, Vector Embeddings, FastAPI, React
- **Description**: Intelligent support assistant processing documentation across Segment, mParticle, Lytics, and Zeotap with semantic search and cross-CDP comparisons.

### 4. Any Search Multi-Threaded Engine
- **Technologies**: C++, Python, Multi-threading, OS File Indexing
- **Description**: High-performance local file indexing tool traversing deep file structures with sub-50ms latency and concurrent search threads.

### 5. Real-Time Data Analytics Hub
- **Technologies**: React, Node.js, WebSockets, Chart.js, Redis
- **Description**: Telemetry streaming pipeline rendering live financial and system metrics, real-time alert thresholds, and multi-tenant performance graphs.

### 6. Immersive 3D Developer Portfolio & Neural Telemetry Engine
- **Technologies**: HTML5, Vanilla CSS Design System, JavaScript, Anime.js, WebGL Canvas
- **Website**: https://sohamsawalakhe.space/
- **Description**: Ultra-luxury engineering portfolio featuring real-time 100-frame character canvas, interactive 3D avatar gaze tracking, Porsche GT3 inspired telemetry scrollytelling, and responsive design.
